desc:
# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/nocturne
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/nocturne

## File: facebookresearch_nocturne/third_party/json/third_party/cpplint/cpplint.py

Prompts

```
['run cpplint on one or more C++ source files to check for Google style guide violations', 'check that C++ header includes follow the correct order: own header, C system, C++ system, other', 'report a lint error with filename, line number, category, confidence level, and message', 'parse and track the nesting state of classes, namespaces, and blocks in C++ code', 'check C++ code for style compliance including spacing, line length, tabs, and brace placement']
```

Usage

```
{'run_cpplint_on_files': 'run cpplint on one or more C++ source files to check for Google style guide violations', 'check_include_order': 'check that C++ header includes follow the correct order: own header, C system, C++ system, other', 'report_lint_error': 'report a lint error with filename, line number, category, confidence level, and message', 'parse_nesting_state': 'parse and track the nesting state of classes, namespaces, and blocks in C++ code', 'check_style_compliance': 'check C++ code for style compliance including spacing, line length, tabs, and brace placement'}
```
